name: MolmoAct2
license_note: Apache 2.0. trust_remote_code executes the checkpoint's modeling code.
notes: Released MolmoAct2 policy, the checkpoint the LeRobot docs fine-tune. Pretraining starts from allenai/Molmo2-ER. The flow-matching action expert is a separate width-768 stack with one block per text layer and is excluded. Both checkpoints use the original Molmo2 layout, which transformers converts while loading (fused att_proj/ff_proj split, vision renamed), so MolmoAct2 is loaded through the same native Molmo2 class and copied name for name. Its base vocabulary is 154624 against Molmo2-ER's 151936; the shared Qwen3 prefix and the 128 image/frame special-token rows (same offsets in both configs) are copied, and its extra action/state rows are dropped. MolmoAct-7B-D is the previous MolmoAct (Qwen2.5-7B), not this model.
convention: lmms-eval textvqa_val without OCR tokens: '{question}\nAnswer the question using a single word or phrase.', greedy; VQA accuracy with the EvalAI answer processor
warnings: model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight: copied rows 0..151935 and the 128 special-token rows (donor rows 154624..154751)
